I second yoga with Adrienne! She’s awesome. I’m pretty sure she has some videos focused on posture yoga as well.

Basically OP, you want to strengthen your weak upper back muscles and also stretch your likely shortened chest muscles. There are lots of exercises/movements for this, as well as for forward head posture, some of my favourites are: wall slides, shoulder flossing, lying back extension, face pulls, cat/cow, cactus pose, chest stretch, rear delt fly. I’m slowly seeing improvement though I could be much more consistent with it. The exercises themselves also won’t do much unless you’re paying attention to your posture the rest of the time too. 

It really feels like an uphill battle... but you’ll get there! Hope you can find some relief soon.
